title: Green active food packaging films based on nanocomposites of PHBV/sepiolite/essential oils
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2025, 3,470-481
DOI: 10.1039/D4FB00232F, Paper

Renata Cerruti da Costa, Pâmela Rosa Oliveira, Leandro Guarezi Nandi, Daiane Mara Bobermin, Marília Miotto, Ismael Casagrande Bellettini, Janaina da Silva Crespo, Tales da Silva Daitx, Cristiano da Silva Teixeira, Larissa Nardini Carli
The incorporation of essential oils results in an antibacterial packaging with more than 99% reduction in bacterial growth. The synergy between components provides a control over the release rate of essential oils into the packaging system.
